ignore.reason: Reader.read/next use the source-and-diagnostic variants, which include the same semantic result, consumed extent and failure detail. The convenience and no-diagnostic variants do not add a separate JS operation.
TreeReader.next/nextEvent and Reader.visit call diagnostic variants; these no-diagnostic entry points have the same traversal and callback behavior.
TreeWriter begin/end/write/writeEvent use the diagnostic variants with identical state and ownership contracts; no-diagnostic aliases are not separate JS operations.

Writer.encode/write/copyEncoded/preserve and measure use persistent element-based diagnostic operations. The one-shot, tag/value, copy-element and no-diagnostic convenience functions provide no additional behavior. Size-only logical measurement is already available through Format.measure({tag, valueSize}); Writer.measure accepts actual content for content-dependent formats.
V1Query passes UTF-8 bytes and their explicit length through tlv_query_parse_n; the NUL-terminated tlv_query_parse variant adds no separate JS operation.

Core callback implementations installed by the bound fields, tagged-fields, variable and escaped descriptor initializers; Format.decode/measure/encode invokes them through the descriptor. They are not separate JS operations.

Binary composition callbacks are reached through Format.fixed. Tagged binary composition is covered by Format.compose with fixed identifier/length fields and tag_only; the specialized initializer and callbacks provide no additional public operation.
Node.encode/encodedSize call the _as variants with the retained Document Format when no alternate Format is supplied; the implicit-format aliases add no behavior.

Document Query visitation uses compiled evaluation plus query_next and JS-owned synchronous visit guards. V1 path visitation is available by compiling the formatted V1Query; native visitor entry points are not separate JS operations.
Schema construction prepares and checks the immutable owned definition once; validate and validateAll use checked variants with the same Core semantics and copied diagnostics.
QueryProgram owns measured compilation storage and uses the diagnostic compile variant; raw scratch allocation and no-diagnostic compilation are C storage/convenience interfaces.
QueryExecution.reset recreates its native execution in retained owned storage and releases pinned input and Document references. The C reset alias does not add a public operation.
V1Query owns its native parsed path and matcher at stable addresses; matcher() creates an independent continuation. Rebinding a borrowed C query pointer is not exposed across WASM.

Raw relocatable-plan views expose borrowed C pointers and layout internals. QueryProgram.load/image/info/explain provide validated owned image access; direct plan inspection is intentionally excluded.
